purpose: Test whether a pre-existing JANUS cross-domain mechanism—FIRST_BREAK localization with ambiguity preservation and causal-isolation controls—extracts reproducible, previously unreported information from public viral trajectory/source data without outcome-driven retargeting.
frozen_primary_question: Does the earliest persistent dynamical regime break in a single-virus trajectory carry reproducible information about a later independently measured interaction state that is not recoverable from whole-trajectory aggregate motion summaries alone?

first_break_operator.candidate_breaks: all admissible interior indices with sufficient observations on both sides
first_break_operator.rule: Select the earliest candidate boundary that survives a predeclared persistence requirement and a nonparametric distribution-shift test across adjacent windows; otherwise emit NO_CERTIFIED_BREAK.
first_break_operator.ambiguity_rule: If multiple boundaries are statistically indistinguishable under the frozen rule, emit a candidate set rather than selecting the cosmetically best singleton.

primary_comparison.first_break_model: uses location and signed local feature change at earliest certified break
primary_comparison.aggregate_baseline: whole-trajectory duration plus global mean step length plus global displacement variance and, where appropriate, global MSD-style summary
primary_comparison.endpoint: out-of-sample prediction or discrimination of a later independently sourced interaction-state label
primary_comparison.required_result: FIRST_BREAK must add reproducible out-of-sample information above the aggregate baseline; in-sample separation is insufficient

null_and_negative_controls: increment-order permutation preserving marginal step-length distribution should destroy order-specific FIRST_BREAK information
time-independent aggregate-preserving surrogate must not reproduce a strong order-specific gain
reversible_or_free-diffusion control should not be force-promoted to a directional first-break mechanism
label permutation must collapse predictive gain to null

required_all: quantitative rule frozen before outcome analysis
raw/source data independent of rule formulation
FIRST_BREAK adds out-of-sample information above aggregate baseline
replication in a second independent viral system or dataset
post-result prior-art search finds no equivalent reported result/method at the claimed scope
result has material scientific consequence rather than only better curve fitting
analysis and provenance are independently replayable
